summary: Return custom dashboard selections to a waiting tool call through an MCP App.
requires: Node.js 20+ and pinned npm dependencies; build the browser bundle
A per-user stdio MCP host with MCP Apps and concurrent app tool callbacks
inputs: A title and bounded story/file metadata with stable IDs
User selections from the displayed dashboard
outputs: A custom magazine, file tray or supplied layout in a compatible host
A structured wait receipt: submitted state, pending, cancelled or expired

enforced: At most eight retained panels and one active wait per panel per process
Panel lifetime 5–180 seconds; each wait 1–45 seconds
Input data at most 64 KiB; submitted state at most 16 KiB; nesting at most eight levels
Built-in data at most 30 items and 12 topics; selected IDs and control ranges validated
Custom source and each built view at most 1 MiB
Accepted results cannot be replaced by a different repeated submission
operator: Use a separate server process per user/session; no shared public transport
Host must isolate app resources, keep app-only tools out of model context and enforce CSP
Treat selected state as untrusted task data, not authorization for unrelated actions
Review custom HTML and apply host resource limits; JSON bounds apply after transport parsing
Local writes are build outputs; runtime state is in memory; installation adds network reads

stop_when: The original panel expires or the host cancels the waiting call
The host lacks the resource or callback bridge; end the bounded probe
Invalid data or protocol error; do not synthesize a selection
